vedic_reference.note: Subash is a Sanskrit name that has its origin in the Sanskrit words सु (su) meaning good, auspicious and बाश (bāś) meaning light, radiance, prosperity. The name is a combination of these two words and holds the meaning of good, auspicious, prosperous. It is a name that is often given to children as a sign of hope and optimism for their future.
